evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: 分析精度を支えるデータ品質・ガバナンス強化
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Data quality and governance recur across four responsibilities ("分析精度を支えるデータ品質・ガバナンス強化", analysis accuracy backed by data quality and governance), against only startup-ambiguity framing, so rigour.
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Analytics for a B2B AI product and its enterprise clients informs decisions without financial-reporting or regulatory language, so moderate.
evidence.collaboration_width: Bizチーム; Productチーム; BizDevメンバー; クライアント; CS
evidence.data_team_maturity: 基盤設計〜分析〜改善提案までを一気通貫で推進できる体制構築
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: The role sits in a new business unit (新規事業) and is asked to build the data foundation and the working setup end to end ("体制構築"), so early.
evidence.jd_authorship: KPI設計・ログ設計・データモデリング
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Bullets name concrete areas such as KPI and log design and DWH/data mart build, but stay short and generic about tools and scale, so mixed.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: BIの民主化（Biz / CSが自らデータを活用できる状態へ）
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: Work splits between client-facing analysis and PoCs, self-serve BI for business and customer-success teams, and product data quality, with no single audience dominating.
evidence.autonomy_level: 不確実な状況でも自ら課題を定義し、推進できる方
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The candidate is expected to decide which data to hold and which analyses matter and to define problems themselves ("自ら課題を定義し、推進できる"), so strategic.
evidence.ai_role: AI分析機能・定性分析基盤の強化
evidence.ai_role_explanation: A responsibility is strengthening the AI analysis features and the qualitative-analysis foundation ("AI分析機能・定性分析基盤の強化"), so the candidate builds data that AI features run on.
evidence.testing_framing: プロダクトのデータ品質向上・計測基盤整備
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Data quality improvement is framed as owned work in several responsibility lines, not just a listed tool.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: データの整合性・再利用性・運用性を考慮して設計できる方
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Consistency and operability of data matter, but the framing is about building value and accurate analysis rather than compliance or stakeholder-trust risk.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: データ基盤（DWH / データマート）の設計・構築
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The first responsibility is designing and building the DWH and data marts for a new business, with standardisation and improvement work alongside, so greenfield.
evidence.loss_aversion: 分析精度を支えるデータ品質・ガバナンス強化 — strengthening data quality and governance to support analysis accuracy.
